name: .408 Cal-272gr Pittman Hammer
note: Recommended use: Smokeless Muzzle Loader Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "The Pittman Hammer was designed in collaboration with Pittman Bullets use in smokeless muzzle loaders for big game hunting. This is the lightest weight of the Pittman Hammers with the small 1.5mm hollow point. This pure copper bullet will create great velocity for your normal to long range hunting needs."
